_about: The App Store listing (en-US). Apply with Actions → App Store → listing. Limits: name 30, subtitle 30, keywords 100 (comma-separated, no spaces, don't repeat words from the name or subtitle), promotional text 170, description 4000.
name: Notchman: Summarize & Listen
subtitle: AI TL;DR & Text to Speech
promotionalText: Copy a long message, article or AI answer, tap the Shiba in your Dynamic Island, and hear what matters in seconds. Every key point and number, out loud.
description:
Too long to read? Hear it instead.

Notchman turns long messages, emails, articles and AI answers into a short spoken TL;DR that keeps every key point, name, date and number. Or have the whole thing read aloud in a natural voice.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Copy any text or link.
2. Press and hold the Shiba in your Dynamic Island.
3. Tap TL;DR, or Read for every word.

Notchman opens, makes the TL;DR and starts talking in seconds.

WHAT YOU GET
• TL;DRs that keep the important points, names, dates and numbers
• Read: the full text, aloud
• Play, pause and skip from the Dynamic Island and the Lock Screen
• Share to Notchman from any app's share sheet
• A Safari extension to listen to the page you're on
• Links to posts and articles are opened and read for you
• Works in the language of your message
• Your history stays on your iPhone

FREE AND PRO
Notchman is free, with daily TL;DRs in the iPhone voice. Notchman Pro and Pro+ add monthly time with the natural Notchman voice:
• Pro: about 28 minutes a month
• Pro+: about 67 minutes a month
Subscriptions renew monthly until cancelled. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings › your name › Subscriptions, at least 24 hours before renewal.

PRIVACY
Notchman only reads what you choose, when you tap. To make your TL;DR and voice, the text is sent to Groq and ElevenLabs, and it isn't stored.

Terms of Use: https://notchman.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://notchman.app/privacy
reviewNotes:
Notchman makes spoken TL;DRs (short summaries) of text the user copies, or reads the text aloud. No account or login is needed.

HOW TO TEST
1. Open the app, tick "I agree" (Terms and Privacy Policy) and tap Continue.
2. Tap Turn On: the user opts in to keep Notchman resting in the Dynamic Island as a Live Activity. It can be turned off anytime in Settings › Keep Notchman in the Dynamic Island.
3. Optional: Settings › Notchman › Paste from Other Apps › Allow, so iOS doesn't ask on every tap.
4. On "Try it now", tap Copy Message, go to the Home Screen, press and hold the Shiba in the Dynamic Island and tap TL;DR. Notchman opens and plays the TL;DR.
Text can also be shared to Notchman from any app's share sheet (Listen with Notchman), or sent from the Notchman Safari extension.

CLIPBOARD
The clipboard is read only when the user taps TL;DR or Read, never in the background.

DATA AND THIRD-PARTY AI (5.1.2)
Before first use, the user agrees on a screen that names the AI services: the chosen text is sent over HTTPS to our server, which uses Groq to write the TL;DR and ElevenLabs to make the voice. The text and audio aren't stored on the server. Listening history stays on the device.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
Notchman Pro and Pro+ (monthly, auto-renewing) are sold with In-App Purchase only (Account › Go Premium, or Settings › See Plans). The free plan works without buying anything.

SIGN IN WITH APPLE
Optional. The credential is kept in the device's keychain only; no account is created on a server. Sign Out removes it.
